# Workspace Instructions

- Keep this project dependency-free and runnable as a static browser app.
- Preserve graceful fallbacks for camera, geolocation, and local storage.
- Car identification and leaderboard rivals are simulated demo data; do not present them as live AI or multiplayer services.
- Keep daily resets based on local midnight and weekly resets on Sunday.
- Item shop stock must retain one Uncommon, Rare, Exotic, and Legendary offer per local 48-hour cycle; the free pack can be claimed once per local day.
- Preserve camera-only scanning, captured-photo garage icons, scan ticket refills, and scraps when changing shared game state.
- Verify scanner, duplicate salvage, item shop purchases, garage filters, leaderboard, quest claims, and mobile layout after changing shared game state.
